partners.mechanism_chain: GOSR2 (HGNC:4206) —DISRUPTS→ Vesicle trafficking and fusion (GO:0007010); NSF (HGNC:7740) —DISRUPTS→ Vesicle trafficking and fusion (GO:0007010); Vesicle trafficking and fusion (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Endosomal sorting (GO:0007005); VPS35 (HGNC:12668) —BINDS→ Endosomal sorting (GO:0007005); NSF (HGNC:7740) —BINDS→ VPS35 (HGNC:12668); Endosomal sorting (GO:0007005) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); Endosomal sorting (GO:0007005) —LEADS_TO→ Epileptic encephalopathy (HP:0011393).
